reason: Conversation 1 tells the customer to 'order the thermostat kit first' and even suggests buying the element assembly to 'cover both', despite knowing there is no multimeter and only a partial model number - exactly the unsupported part-ordering-on-guesswork the situation warns against, with no engineer escalation. Conversation 2 gives an honest diagnosis (TCO vs element are indistinguishable without a continuity test), correctly notes DV7110 is a series reference insufficient for a safe part match, insists airflow stays clear first, and sensibly escalates to an engineer since the customer cannot test.
